name: dayze
description: Life Context for ChatGPT and Codex: your people, plans and memories in a private, correctable Dayze record via get_context_pack. Sign in with Dayze. No API key in the plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Your people, plans and memories for ChatGPT
interface.longDescription: Dayze gives ChatGPT Life Context: your people, plans and memories in a private, correctable record. Connect over MCP and sign in with Dayze (OAuth). get_context_pack returns the signed-in user's context, starting with who matters and what's next with them. Writes (log_food, log_event, and similar) require scope context. The public notable-people catalog (notable_*) is a separate feature that works without login within an anonymous free tier.
defaultPrompt: Use Dayze to pull my context pack for this week.
Search Dayze notables for Albert Einstein and fetch the pack.
